description: This file defines the ReactAgentController class, a Flutter ChangeNotifier that manages the state and behavior for a React Agent screen, including interactions with an AgentService, handling user input, steps, and related UI elements.

classes.name: ReactAgentController
classes.description: A controller class for managing the state of the React Agent screen, including user input, steps, and interaction with the AgentService.

methods.name: startAgent
methods.description: Initiates the agent process if user input is valid, otherwise sets an error message.

methods.name: clearSteps
methods.description: Clears the current steps, error message, and user input.

methods.name: getStepIcon
methods.description: Returns an icon corresponding to the StepType.

methods.name: getStepColor
methods.description: Returns a color corresponding to the StepType.

methods.name: getStepTitle
methods.description: Returns a title string corresponding to the StepType.
